messages:
Maria Chen: Hey team — I'm in my first week and getting set up for on-call. Where are the runbooks kept? Also how do I get PagerDuty access and do new hires shadow before they take pages? Thanks!

Devon Park: Welcome aboard! Add your work email to the oncall group and I'll invite you to PagerDuty. Yes — we require 2 shadow shifts + 1 supervised solo before you're on rotation. Runbooks are in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/oncall (start with 'Triage checklist' and 'P1 playbook').

Maria Chen: Thanks! I tried Confluence but I don't have access yet — I filed a request. Who should I ping if it stalls?

Sara B: @Devon can add you to the oncall group today; infra usually approves Confluence within an hour after that. Also FYI there's a 30-min on-call walkthrough tomorrow 10:30am in #eng-oncall — Devon will share the calendar invite.

Devon Park: Invite sent. Also make sure you can reach the jumpbox: `ssh -A maria@jump.redwood.internal` — if your key is rejected, DM me and I'll add it to the allowed list.

Alex Rodriguez: Quick heads-up: P1 escalation window is 15m, rotations are 1 week by default. We'll pair you with me for your first shadow shift (I'll walk through a simulated incident).

oncall-bot: Reminder: new-oncall-training module assigned to Maria Chen. Complete it before your first supervised solo: https://training.redwood/new-oncall

Maria Chen: Awesome, thanks everyone. One more Q: where's the postmortem template so I can skim it before the walkthrough?

Sara B: Confluence > templates > incident-postmortem. I'll DM the direct link. :thumbsup: 

Devon Park: Also bookmark the quick links in the runbook, especially the Slack escalation snippet and the mitigation checklist. Ping here if anything blocks you before tomorrow.
